description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 511000
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for various parcels in the Gampaha District. It contains detailed land parcel information including plot numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
